description: Consume three distinct owned relic instances of the same rarity (their types may differ) to create a random relic of the next rarity, following the human fusion cost. Legendary relics, mixed rarities and foreign instances are refused. Equipped consumed instances are unequipped. Liquid pays before locked; all FA cost goes to buyback.

relic_ids.description: Three distinct INSTANCE ids from forge_inventory, not catalogue types.
